hypotheses.justification: The only place the proof needs finiteness is `IsPGroup.iff_card`, which takes `[Finite ↥Q]`. The statement never mentions `Finite G`. Finiteness of `↥Q` follows from the other hypotheses: `e : ↥Q ≃* QuaternionGroup N` and `[NeZero N]` give a Fintype instance on `QuaternionGroup N`, so `Finite ↥Q` comes from `Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm.toEquiv`. Add `haveI : Finite ↥Q := Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm.toEquiv` at the start of the proof. `card_quat` does not use `Finite G`. `Fact (Nat.Prime 2)` is a Mathlib instance. The rest of the proof is pure arithmetic and is unchanged. The theorem therefore remains true and provable without `Finite G`.
